items.quote: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
items.claim: The text says a man with an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father fought with an Israelite man inside the camp.
items.actor: son of an Israelitish woman and an Egyptian father
items.mechanism: a quarrel in the camp between a man of mixed parentage and an Israelite

items.quote: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed.
items.claim: The text says the Israelite woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord and cursed.
items.mechanism: verbal offence against the divine name

items.quote: And they brought him unto Moses:
items.claim: The text says the offender was brought to Moses to be judged.
items.mechanism: the case was sent up to the community's leader

items.quote: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
items.claim: The text names the offender's mother as Shelomith, daughter of Dibri, from the tribe of Dan.
items.mechanism: family and tribal lineage traced through the mother

items.quote: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
items.claim: The text says the offender was held in custody until the Lord's will about the case was made known.
items.mechanism: held in custody until a ruling came from God
